λέχρις ἐπιχριμφθ〈είς〉: leaning sideways toward the spring. The sense: when she lowered the water-jar to the spring, as the water was pouring into the vessel with a loud noise, the nymph took hold of his neck with her left hand and kissed him, and with her right hand she pulled him down into the water.
